findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: Content Security Policy (CSP) is an added layer of security that helps detect and mitigate Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection attacks.
findings.evidence: Content-Security-Policy HTTP response header was not present in target response.
findings.impact: Attacks like Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and data injection can run malicious scripts in the victim browser context.
findings.remediation: Implement a strong Content-Security-Policy header, e.g., "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self';"

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking Protection)
findings.description: The X-Frame-Options header indicates whether a browser should be allowed to render a page in a frame, iframe, embed or object.
findings.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors directive was detected.
findings.impact: Attackers can embed the application in an invisible iframe on a malicious website to perform Clickjacking attacks.
findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options header to DENY or SAMEORIGIN.

findings.title: Missing or Misconfigured X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.description: The X-Content-Type-Options header prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing a response away from the declared content-type.
findings.impact: Browsers may interpret non-executable MIME types as executable JavaScript, leading to XSS.
findings.remediation: Add header: "X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff"

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.description: The Referrer-Policy HTTP header controls how much referrer information (sent via the Referer header) should be included with requests.
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy header was omitted from response headers.
findings.impact: Sensitive URL parameters or session tokens may leak to external domains via the Referer header.
findings.remediation: Set Referrer-Policy to "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" or "no-referrer".

findings.title: Server Information Disclosure via HTTP Headers
findings.description: HTTP response headers expose specific server software version numbers and backend technologies.
findings.impact: Attackers can use exposed technology versions to look up targeted software vulnerabilities (CVEs).
findings.remediation: Remove X-Powered-By header and suppress detailed Server software version banners.

findings.title: Technology Stack Detected
findings.description: Fingerprinted active web software, frameworks, and client libraries.
findings.impact: Identifying tech stack versions assists security teams in audit and patch management.
findings.remediation: Ensure all detected software libraries and server components are kept updated to latest security patches.

findings.title: Insecure Cookie: Missing SameSite Attribute (GPS)
findings.description: The cookie "GPS" does not specify a SameSite attribute (Lax or Strict).
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie: GPS=1; Domain=.youtube.com; Expires=Sun, 04-Oct-2026 17:25:30 GMT; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly
findings.impact: Increases susceptibility to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks.
findings.remediation: Set "SameSite=Lax" or "SameSite=Strict" on Set-Cookie attributes.

findings.title: Technology Stack Detected
findings.description: Fingerprinted active web software, frameworks, and client libraries.
findings.evidence: Discovered Technologies: ESF (Web Server), React (UI Library), Bootstrap (CSS Framework)
findings.impact: Identifying tech stack versions assists security teams in audit and patch management.
findings.remediation: Ensure all detected software libraries and server components are kept updated to latest security patches.

findings.title: Sensitive Path Disclosure via robots.txt
findings.description: The robots.txt file discloses hidden administrative or backup paths.
findings.impact: Search engine crawlers are instructed not to index these paths, but malicious scanners use robots.txt to discover hidden admin panels.
findings.remediation: Do not rely on robots.txt for access control. Implement real authentication and authorization on hidden paths.

findings.title: TLS Certificate Near Expiration
findings.description: The SSL/TLS certificate for web.whatsapp.com will expire in 8 days.
findings.evidence: Certificate Valid To: Oct 20 23:59:59 2026 GMT. Days Remaining: 8
findings.impact: An expired SSL certificate causes browser security warnings and service outages.
findings.remediation: Renew the SSL/TLS certificate prior to expiration.

findings.title: SEC-HDR-CSP-MISSING
findings.description: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.severity: Content-Security-Policy restricts resource loading origins, mitigating Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and data injection vectors.
findings.impact: https://portfolio-hemanthkumara.netlify.app/
findings.remediation: Response headers inspected; "content-security-policy" header was absent.

findings.title: SEC-HDR-XFO-MISSING
findings.description: Missing Clickjacking Defense (X-Frame-Options / frame-ancestors)
findings.severity: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors directive was detected to restrict framing of the target page.
findings.impact: https://portfolio-hemanthkumara.netlify.app/
findings.remediation: Neither "x-frame-options" nor CSP "frame-ancestors" was present in HTTP response headers.

findings.title: SEC-HDR-XCTO-MISSING
findings.description: Missing or Improper X-Content-Type-Options Header
findings.severity: The X-Content-Type-Options header instructs browsers to strictly respect declared MIME types and disable MIME-sniffing.
findings.impact: https://portfolio-hemanthkumara.netlify.app/
findings.remediation: X-Content-Type-Options value: "NOT_SET"

findings.title: SEC-HDR-RP-MISSING
findings.description: Missing Referrer-Policy Header
findings.severity: The Referrer-Policy HTTP header governs how much referrer metadata is transmitted with outgoing navigation and subresource requests.
findings.impact: https://portfolio-hemanthkumara.netlify.app/
findings.remediation: Referrer-Policy header was omitted from HTTP response headers.

findings.title: SEC-HDR-PERM-MISSING
findings.description: Missing Permissions-Policy Header
findings.severity: Permissions-Policy allows developers to explicitly restrict access to browser hardware features such as camera, microphone, geolocation, and payment APIs.
findings.impact: https://portfolio-hemanthkumara.netlify.app/
findings.remediation: Permissions-Policy header was absent from server response.

findings.description: Server Banner & Technology Version Disclosure

findings.remediation: Disclosed Headers: Server: Netlify
